title: Fix the Unchecked Array-Based Stack Overflow
description: The program should push values onto a fixed-size stack, rejecting pushes once it's full.
expectedBehavior: After the stack is full (3 elements), a fourth push should be rejected instead of corrupting memory.
actualProblem: push() never checks whether top has already reached the array's last valid index (MAX - 1) before writing. The fourth push writes to stack[3], one element past the end of the 3-element array — a buffer overflow.
explanation: A fixed-size, array-based stack must check for the full condition (top == MAX - 1) before every push, and reject the operation instead of writing past the array's bounds.
